tasks.prompt: A server processes 240 requests in 15 minutes at a constant rate. How many requests does it process in 40 minutes? Reply with only the number.
A cluster has 3 nodes. Two nodes are running 8 jobs each and the third node is running 5 jobs. How many jobs are running in total? Reply with only the number.
A benchmark repeats each of 4 probe classes 3 times, once for each of 2 prompt variants. How many total probe requests does that make? Reply with only the number.
